title: console FormPage: a refused create shows the raw server JSON envelope to the end user ("Create failed (403): {"error":…})
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect, found beside the clauses (studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix), reach: the console named form page, measured once with a deterministic cause in source.
Business reason: an end user without create rights who opens a form link (`/_console/forms/NAME`) fills it in and presses Submit, and is shown the server's raw JSON in English: `Create failed (403): {"error":"You do not have permission…","code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"…"}`. The report page tells the same user "You don't have access"; the form should give a readable, localized refusal (and ideally not offer a create form the caller cannot submit).
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`. QA suggestion only: `area:records`, p2.
Duplicate search: `"Create failed"` → 271 hits, the near ones closed and different (#24914 raw node text in a screen flow, #25938 FLOW_FAILED rendering); `FormPage 403 raw JSON` → 9 hits, all QA run records or checklist revisions.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. A member m1 with read but no create on object `qar8_fsb`, which has a default form view.
2. As m1, open `/_console/forms/qar8_fsb.form`. The form renders fully, with no "no access" state.
3. Fill Name and press Submit → `POST /api/v1/data/qar8_fsb` → 403.

Expected: a localized refusal sentence, without the JSON envelope. Actual: the banner and the toast read verbatim `Create failed (403): {"error":"You do not have permission to perform this action. Contact your administrator if you need access.","code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"qar8_fsb"}`.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`FormPage.tsx` about L1968–1969 builds the message as a template of the verb, the status and the raw body; `refusedWriteError` (about L1990) parses code and details but keeps that raw message.
